description: A 429 with `Retry-After`. Returned as data, `retryable: true`, with the wait in seconds. (Run with retries disabled, so the SDK's own retry does not absorb it.) The problem's `next_step` (the API's sentence for the code) follows the detail in `message`.

body.title: Too many requests
body.detail: Burst limit of 10 requests per second exceeded.
body.next_step: Retry after the `Retry-After` header's seconds; the request was not run.

error.message: Burst limit of 10 requests per second exceeded. Retry after the `Retry-After` header's seconds; the request was not run.
